::: {#def-confidence-interval}
#### Confidence interval

A $100(1-\siglevel)\%$ **confidence interval** for a parameter $\param$
is a random [closed interval](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/sets.html#def-closed-interval)
$\cintf{X}$
whose endpoints $\cilof{X} \le \ciupf{X}$
are statistics computed from the data $X$,
such that for every possible value of $\param$:

$$\Pr_{\param}\paren{\param \in \cintf{X}} \ge 1 - \siglevel$$

The probability is over repeated samples from the data-generating process,
with $\param$ held fixed.
The interval is random and $\param$ is not.

Source: [@CaseBerg01, Definitions 9.1.1, 9.1.4 and 9.1.5].
:::
